product_metadata.title: Baxton Studio Gabrielle White-Finished 3-Drawer Wood Dresser
features: With its floral embellishments, the Gabrielle cabinet is a charming addition to any bedroom. Constructed from wood, this cabinet features three spacious drawers. Its classic white finish highlights the stunning attention to detail in the inset paneling on the drawers, as well as the enchanting floral molding on the bottom. Decorative brass metal handles and cabriole legs add a delightful French-inspired look. The Gabrielle cabinet is made in China and will arrive fully assembled
Constructed from MDF wood and fir wood
description: Traditional French Provincial storage cabinet Constructed from MDF wood and fir wood White finish Three (3) drawers Decorative brass metal handles Fully assembled Dimensions: 31.5" high x 31.5" Wide x 13.78" deep; Drawer dimensions: 5.91" high x 25.59" Wide x 11.81" deep; Legs: 9.84" high; Weight: 39.68
